root_cause.summary: Lookahead limiter is bypassed at the factory default (limiterDb = 0). Soft-ceiling alone (threshold 0.985, knee 0.014 linear) is the only protection and audibly distorts on sustained high-gain content.

evidence.claim: Soft ceiling threshold 0.985, ceiling 0.999, knee ~0.12 dB
Header states 'lookahead delay is always active' which code does not implement

always_on_limiter.rationale: Lookahead path already implemented and contract-tested. Always-on costs lookahead delay + per-sample comparison. currentGain stays at 1.0 when peaks under threshold; output bit-identical to pre-fix on clean material.
concrete_actions: Remove if-gate at OutputChain.cpp:278; call limiter.process unconditionally
Clamp sanitizeLimiterDb range to [-12.0, -0.1] to avoid colliding with internal 0.9885531 gate

trade_offs.transparency: Bit-identical when peaks <= threshold; transient lookahead delay (88 samples) is musically inaudible
trade_offs.highgain_feel: Improves: transients controlled with lookahead instead of tanh saturation against narrow soft-ceiling knee
trade_offs.clean_path: Untouched; limiter currentGain == 1.0 on clean material
trade_offs.fuzz_reference: Fuzz character preserved internally; limiter only acts when fuzz Level=1 sends peaks > -0.3 dBTP
trade_offs.latency: Constant 2 ms reported once at prepare; no PDC flip-flop
trade_offs.preset_compatibility: No schema bump; sanitizers absorb out-of-range legacy values

master_gain_range.rationale: Removes ducking failure mode when users park master at +12 dB; preserves legitimate make-up for low-output passive guitars; draft presets all ship master <= 0 dB so unaffected

soft_ceiling_knee.rationale: After always-on limiter, soft ceiling should be insurance for parameter-automation transients, denormal sticks, NaN recovery only. Widening knee would add audible softening on amp transients; reject.

chain_level_headroom_trims.rationale: Pedal/amp outputTrim values are voiced; re-tuning them to make the limiter not duck is fake safety that trades tone for clean meters. Treat persistent ducking as a misvoicing bug in the offending pedal, not a global trim issue.

top_risks.summary: Latency must be reported ONCE at prepare; toggling the threshold knob must not change reported latency or DAWs will re-PDC and glitch.
Fuzz Level=1 may trigger limiter on peaks; null-test A/B against pre-fix on a fuzz-only preset to confirm sustain unaffected.
Existing P9E high_gain_staccato_proxy peaks at 0.12, never exercises the bug. New scenario required before fix can be auditably PASSed.
User-saved presets with master > +6 dB will silently clamp via sanitizer. UX comms note.
Limiter internal per-sample active-gate at 0.9885531 (~ -0.1 dB) must not collide with default threshold -0.3 dBTP. Enforce by clamp range [-12, -0.1].

post_fix_validation: null-test against pre-fix build with limiter forced bypass on clean material; expect bit-identical

new high-gain scenario: HighGainAmp drive=10 + Modern4x12 + master=0 dB + pink+chord input at -6 dBFS; expect limiterActiveBlocks > 0 AND softCeilingTouchedSamples == 0 AND limiterMaxReductionDb <= 6.0
fuzz A/B at Level=1 on FuzzPedal-only preset; expect sustain RMS delta < 1.0e-3
host PDC delta across full limiter knob sweep == 0
verdict: Adopt always-on limiter, narrow master upper bound, tighten soft ceiling. Reject chain-level trims. Run new high-gain scenario before approval.
